body:
A few years ago I recieved a bottle of injectable epinephrine AKA adrenaline. The person I got it from was a heavy meth user and was using it to beef up his speed injections. I tried it iv a couple of times, and I tell you true, there is nothing even remotely fun about an adrenaline rush. Your heart feels like it is trying to force itself out of your chest, your stomach aches and your head feels like a balloon about to pop. This experience has led me to believe that the so-called adrenaline rush is a pop-culture myth and that the rush of bungee-jumping and sky-diving is mediated by endorphins.
Anyhow, I decided to synthesize some adrenochrome. This was done fairly easily, just acid-base extraction followed by oxidation with potassium permanganate in the presence of HCl. The final product was a brownish yellow oily substance. This was injected iv a few mg at a time up to 21 mg over an hour.
The effects were not very interesting. This drug is nothing like it is portrayed in 'Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas.' It felt a lot like the come-down from a 4 day meth binge. Paranoia, shadow people seen out of the corner of the eye, inability to think straight. No rush, no euphoria, no real visuals, but ther was considerable nausea and anxiety. Perhaps this could really blow your mind at higher doses, but I doubt that it is worth the side effects.
